description: This file defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for managing a Flash Circular Buffer (FCB) in Zephyr OS, including entry management, walking, rotation, and raw flash operations.

methods.name: fcb_init
methods.description: Initializes an FCB instance with specified flash area ID.

methods.name: fcb_append
methods.description: Appends a new entry to the circular buffer.

methods.name: fcb_append_finish
methods.description: Completes the append operation for an entry.

methods.name: fcb_walk
methods.description: Iterates over all entries in the FCB, calling a callback for each.

methods.name: fcb_getnext
methods.description: Retrieves the next FCB entry location.

methods.name: fcb_rotate
methods.description: Rotates the sectors, erasing oldest data.

methods.name: fcb_append_to_scratch
methods.description: Uses a scratch sector for appending data.

methods.name: fcb_free_sector_cnt
methods.description: Returns the number of free sectors.

methods.name: fcb_is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the FCB is empty.

methods.name: fcb_offset_last_n
methods.description: Retrieves the last N entries from the FCB.

methods.name: fcb_flash_read
methods.description: Reads raw data from a flash sector.

methods.name: fcb_flash_write
methods.description: Writes raw data to a flash sector.
